verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 ships an official CLI, `s0`, published in its own GitHub org (sandbox0-ai/s0). Its docs describe running `s0` non-interactively in GitHub Actions for image build/push, template updates and sandbox orchestration, which suits scripted, agent-driven workflows. Missing for 10: command reference and install documentation in the pack, explicit agent-facing CLI features (e.g., structured/JSON output), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
